decisions.reason: As a more specialized handle it still carries some market uncertainty, but its fit with the firm's barrier-free and system-solution strategy gives it enough option value to retain for another year.
The award-winning collection is closely aligned with the firm's design-led specification business and broad coordinated ranges, so it remains a strong product with very low withdrawal risk.
A finish variant is inexpensive to maintain and supports architects' material and aesthetic choices across the portfolio, so it should stay unless demand or range complexity clearly turns against it.
